prompt: A DNS server has the IP address `192.168.0.1`. Which of the following must be applied to a client to use this DNS server? (Choose two.)
choices: Ensure the `dns` service is listed in the `hosts` entry in `/etc/nsswitch.conf`
explanation: List the server in `/etc/resolv.conf` and make sure `/etc/nsswitch.conf` uses `dns` for host lookups.
